messages:
Priya (AE): Quick sync — ACME pilot ask: 6-week pilot for RAG-powered support assistant. Need to lock scope, success metrics, SE staffing, and make sure security Qs are covered. Can we align this week?
Jordan (SE): +1. Can we confirm expected traffic pattern? bursty vs steady. Also what model latency targets they care about.
Priya (AE): Customer expects ~20-50 QPS peak, mostly short chats, some long context threads. Target P50 < 150ms, P95 < 400ms for hosted endpoint. They want 90% intent accuracy on 1k eval prompts.
Jordan (SE): Ok. For 50 QPS sustained we recommend Dedicated small pool (2x A100 equiv) for predictable perf. Need 1 SE half-time for onboarding + 1 eng on-call access first 2 weeks.
Liam (Eng): FYI dedicated sizing: with quantized Llama2-70B-4bit-ish we can hit that with batching tweaks. Will need 24/7 prod key handoff window for initial rollout.
Marta (Security): I have the customer's SSQ v2.3. I can triage. Main ask: data residency and KMS. ACME wants logs off by default and customer-managed KMS. That is doable in Private/Dedicated.
Ben (Finance): Pricing question from ACME: do they get a trial credit or discounted committed rate for 6-week pilot? What are the finance guardrails?
Nora (CS): From CS side we'll run weekly check-ins and own success criteria tests. I propose these success gates: 1) integration passes auth + logs off; 2) 90% pass on intent eval; 3) <200ms P50; 4) no critical security findings.
Priya (AE): Nice. Can we convert those into deliverables + owners + deadlines? Quick draft:
- Week 0 (pre-eng): Security Q completed (Marta) + order signed (Priya) + pilot env provisioned (Jordan)
- Week 1: Ingest connectors + baseline eval run (Nora/Jordan)
- Week 2: Prompt tuning and eval iteration (Jordan)
- Week 3: Load test + perf tuning (Liam/Jordan)
- Week 4: Beta with subset of users, monitor metrics (Nora)
- Week 5: Final eval + handover docs (Jordan/Nora)
- Week 6: Wrap + ROI review (Priya/Ben)
Jordan (SE): Looks good. For staffing I count: SE 0.5 FTE weeks 0-5, Eng 0.2 FTE for perf tuning weeks 2-3, On-call rotation covered by eng-runtime (Liam). Need approval for 16 hours SE prep.
Marta (Security): I'll need access to their vendor SOC2 and an SCT for KMS. ETA 3 business days once docs are in.
Ben (Finance): We can approve a one-time pilot discount of 30% off hosted usage or a $25k pilot credit for Dedicated evaluation. Which does AE prefer?
Priya (AE): Pilot credit preferred — keeps them in dedicated testing without confusing billing. I'll propose $25k credit and a short T&Cs addendum.
Nora (CS): On evals — I'll upload a 1k prompt set and a golden-labeled intent file. We should measure: exact intent match, top-1 correctness, and hallucination flags. Pass threshold 90% top-1.
Jordan (SE): Add system checks: prefix caching enabled, batch size limits, and a canary model route for fallback. I'll upload config snippet:
```
route: pilot-acme
model: rdm-7b-quant
batching: autoscale: true
cache: prefix_kv: true
fallback: rdm-3b-fallback
```
Liam (Eng): We'll set SLOs in console and wire up tracing. Also recommend enabling token-level cost reporting for them so we can estimate $/1k tokens during pilot.
Marta (Security): Note: customer requires deletion of logs older than 30 days for pilot. We'll enable log retention policy and document.
Priya (AE): Action items agreed: 1) Priya: finalize pilot credit T&Cs by EOD tomorrow; 2) Jordan: provision env + share runbook by Mon; 3) Nora: upload eval set by Tue; 4) Marta: complete SSQ triage by Wed; 5) Ben: confirm accounting credit flow by Wed.
deploy-bot: Provisioning job started for env pilot-acme (job id: rwd-provision-7812)
Jordan (SE): thanks. If folks can ACK owners here I'll schedule kickoff with ACME for Monday 10am PT.
Ben (Finance): ACK — I'll loop in accounting.
Marta (Security): ACK — will start SSQ.
Nora (CS): ACK — eval set going up tonight.
Liam (Eng): ACK — will standby for perf window.
Priya (AE): ACK — booking Monday 10am PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
